product_one_liner.value: Trackforce provides security firms and enterprise security teams with software to manage guards, scheduling, patrols, incidents, reporting, and back-office operations.

pricing_page.notes: Dedicated public pricing page describes modular purchasing and custom quotes; dollar prices are not published.

hq_location.notes: The company’s own recruiting copy explicitly identifies Dallas, Texas as headquarters; third-party profiles still list Reston.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog contains security-operations, product, and business content, not two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Enterprise Sales Director – NORAM and Major Accounts Account Manager; neither has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The AI product, security, privacy, legal and related blog materials reviewed do not identify an underlying model or model provider; no public named AI-subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are explicit audit/certification claims. GDPR is a compliance commitment, not a certification; it is included because the question explicitly requests that framework.

last_funding.notes: Conflicting latest-round records could not be reconciled: K1’s primary announcement reports over $150 million committed in September 2019; Tracxn lists September 2019 as latest, while CB Insights reports a July 2023 Series B of $0.37 million. No corroborating announcement for the latter was located, so a definitive latest-round stage/date/amount is withheld.

raised_18mo.notes: Both funding histories place the latest reported round before 2025-05-09: September 2019 in Tracxn, July 2023 in CB Insights.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Under the requested title-based rule, the two advertised titles are Enterprise Sales Director and Major Accounts Account Manager, both excluded. The Account Manager description does call the position a Major Accounts Account Executive, so there is a title/description inconsistency.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-06-09, Trackforce introduced Job-Based Views: five live, role-specific operational views available to every TrackTik customer.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Scott Kaine’s appointment as CEO was announced on 2026-01-12; outgoing CEO Byron McDuffie remained as a strategic advisor.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce and sales-engagement tools appear in a live sales posting; HubSpot and advertising platforms appear in the readable Digital Marketing Specialist posting.
